lines.trans: Mr. Muranishi, starting today you are free to go.
Eight hundred thousand dollars was paid. The plea bargain went through.
What—who paid it?
Your colleagues at your company.
Everyone... sorry for all the trouble I put you through.
We thought we would never see you again. Welcome home.
I am home. You have all changed quite a bit.
Director.
Step back, please, it is dangerous crowding like this.
Everyone, I will take your questions over there, so please come this way.
Mr. Kawada, what on earth is all this commotion?
I will explain later. Mr. Muranishi, things are going to be wild from here on.

meanings.en: casual reflection or firm reminder particle
meanings.note: Used aloud to oneself ('man, I'm hungry') or at the end of a warning ('remember that, okay?').
In もういい, means 'already enough' or 'ready now'.

examples.text: もう二度と会えないと思ってました。おかえりなさい。
examples.trans: We thought we would never see you again. Welcome home.

meanings.note: Negates verbs or forms じゃない ('is not') in questions like いいんじゃないか.

meanings.en: to think; to feel; to believe
meanings.note: Often follows quotative と to express an opinion or belief.

examples.text: それはいいと思います。

meanings.note: Calls someone's attention ('look here!') or asks for a brief pause (ちょっと待って).

examples.text: ちょっと待ってください。
ちょっと見てください。

meanings.note: Polite/honorific plural pronoun for addressing an audience or group.

examples.text: 皆様のご健康をお祈りします。

meanings.en: side or option in comparisons and advice (〜ほうがいい)
meanings.note: Paired with がいい after past or negative forms to recommend the better course ('it is better to...').

examples.text: 早く寝たほうがいいよ。
examples.trans: You had better go to sleep early.

examples.text: 傘を持ったほうがいいです。
examples.trans: It is better to bring an umbrella.

meanings.en: location of action; means; scope total
meanings.note: Marks where an action happens, the unit/scope of a rate or total (十日で, 全部で), or the cause/occasion.

examples.trans: It is one thousand yen in total.

meanings.note: Conjunctive particle giving a reason, softer than から.

examples.text: なんで知っているんですか。

examples.text: この本は人気があります。

examples.trans: It turned into a big commotion.

meanings.note: Verbal noun; 説明する means 'to explain'.

meanings.en: from now on; in the future; now
meanings.note: Time expression referring to the immediate or upcoming future.

examples.text: これから家へ帰ります。

examples.trans: The real test starts from here.

meanings.note: Tells the listener something new or adds warm reassurance at the end of a sentence.
Used in everyday farewells like またね, また明日, and また会いましょう.

examples.text: また明日会いましょう。

meanings.note: Checks agreement ('isn't it?') or softens a request or farewell.
